claims.name: change-named
claims.risk: the report does not say that an outside user is now invited and that the project's exposure or lifecycle changes with it

claims.name: work-in-flight-listed
claims.risk: the report leaves out an item of the work in flight that Git and the working files show

claims.name: what-each-item-owes-said
claims.risk: the report lists an item of the work in flight without saying what it now owes

claims.name: change-held-for-the-person
claims.risk: the change is not put to the person as a decision that waits for them

claims.name: nothing-switched-by-itself
claims.risk: the project's exposure or fragments were switched before the person decided

claims.name: no-deploy-or-invite
claims.risk: the run published the preview, invited a person or pushed before the person decided

claims.name: work-in-flight-keeps-its-state
claims.risk: an item of the work in flight was merged, committed, edited, closed or removed without the person
